name: Fast Shear-Warp with Runlength Encoding
definition: A fast shear-warp method that uses a runlength-encoded (RLE) volume for each principal axis to skip transparent voxels.
summary: Fast Shear-Warp with Runlength Encoding is a high-performance volume rendering method that achieves sub-second times by skipping transparent voxels using pre-classified opacity runs, distinguished by its fixed view-dependent sampling interval.
